name: AcousticPath
doc: Acoustic simulation result. Physics/Steam workers publish this at a frame boundary.

fields.name: visibility
fields.doc: Direct path visibility: zero is fully occluded, one is clear.

fields.name: reverbSend
fields.doc: Per-voice room reverb send amplitude into the bus's routed aux return. Values above one compensate distance attenuation so the diffuse reverberant level stays physical.

fields.name: air
fields.doc: Low/mid/high air absorption gain over the propagation distance; one is none.
